articles.title: MTL@BOS: What you need to know
MacKinnon, Makar sustain lower-body injuries in Avalanche loss

out.detail: lower body injury, out at least one month
lower body injury, out approximately two weeks

away.summary: The Avalanche (11-6-3) are missing key players Nathan MacKinnon and Cale Makar to lower-body injuries sustained in Thursday's loss to Ottawa. Gavin Brindley will make his NHL debut alongside Brent Burns, who plays his 1,600th game. Colorado is on the road for the second half of a back-to-back.

home.summary: The Canadiens (12-3-4) are without Chris Kreider (6-8 weeks) and Samuel Montembeault, with Jakub Dobes projected to start. Mike Matheson is a game-time decision, with Adam Engstrom available as a defensive replacement. Florian Xhekaj returns to the lineup after two games as a healthy scratch.
